title: Deep learning for the harmonization of structural MRI scans: a survey

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Deep learning for the harmonization of structural MRI scans: a survey》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-11】The overall aim of this review is to serve as a guide for researchers and practitioners to select appropriate architectures based on their specific conditions and requirements.

【Abstract · abstract-1-12】It also aims to foster discussions around ongoing challenges in the field and shed light on promising future research directions with the potential for significant advancements.
